# Nova Clinics
# https://www.novaclinics.co.uk/llms.txt

Nova Clinics is a UK private clinic providing online ADHD and autism assessments for children aged 8 and over, young people and adults across the United Kingdom. Nova Clinics is an independent private provider and does not accept NHS Right to Choose funding or GP referrals.

Website: https://www.novaclinics.co.uk
Email: team@novaclinics.co.uk
Service area: United Kingdom (online only; no walk-in clinic).

Services:
- Full ADHD assessment: £1,000
- Full autism assessment: £2,400
- Combined autism + ADHD assessment: £3,000
Assessments are online via video call, NICE-aligned, and led by HCPC-registered clinical psychologists. Online ADHD and autism assessments are for ages 8 and above; ADHD assessments are not offered under age 8. A hybrid face-to-face autism pathway for children under 8 is being set up. Reports typically within 4 weeks (often about 10 working days after the final appointment). Nova Clinics does not prescribe medication; patients should speak with their GP.

How it works (https://www.novaclinics.co.uk/#how-it-works):

Child ADHD:
1. Online questionnaires (60+ minutes)
2. Parent/carer interview (90 minutes)
3. Child/young person observation (60 minutes)
4. Multi-disciplinary team review
5. Report and feedback session (30 minutes)
6. Post-assessment follow-up (within 4 weeks of feedback)

Child autism:
1. Online questionnaires (60+ minutes)
2. Parent/carer interview (90 minutes)
3. Child/young person observation (60 minutes)
4. Multi-disciplinary team review
5. Report and feedback session (30 minutes)
6. Post-assessment follow-up (within 4 weeks of feedback)

Child combined autism and ADHD:
1. Online questionnaires (60+ minutes)
2. Parent/carer interview (150 minutes)
3. Child/young person observation (60 minutes)
4. Multi-disciplinary team review
5. Report and feedback session (under 45 minutes)
6. Post-assessment follow-up (within 4 weeks of feedback)

Adult ADHD:
1. Online questionnaires (60 minutes)
2. Personal interview (90 minutes)
3. Informant interview (60 minutes)
4. Multi-disciplinary team review
5. Report and feedback session (60 minutes)
6. Post-assessment follow-up (within 4 weeks of feedback)

Adult autism:
1. Online questionnaires (60 minutes)
2. Personal interview (90 minutes)
3. Informant interview (60 minutes)
4. Multi-disciplinary team review
5. Report and feedback session (60 minutes)
6. Post-assessment follow-up (within 4 weeks of feedback)

Adult combined autism and ADHD:
1. Online questionnaires (60 minutes)
2. Personal interview (150 minutes)
3. Informant interview (60 minutes)
4. Multi-disciplinary team review
5. Report and feedback session (60 minutes)
6. Post-assessment follow-up (within 4 weeks of feedback)
